    theorem LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.exists_full_twoSidedEndomorphismSpan {k : Type w} [Field k] {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] [∀ (T : C), IsLocalRing (CategoryTheory.End T)] [∀ (T : C), IsArtinianRing (CategoryTheory.End T)] [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k C] (X Y : C) [Module.Finite k (X ⟶ Y)] :
    ∃ (f : X ⟶ Y), twoSidedEndomorphismSpan k f = ⊤

    Comparable principal spans in a finite-dimensional Hom space have a largest member, and that member is the whole Hom space. This is the operational maximal Hom generator denoted pi(x,y) in BGRS 1.3/3.7.

      ∃ tau ∈ Ring.jacobson (CategoryTheory.End X), tau ≠ 0 ∧ twoSidedEndomorphismSpan k tau = endRadicalSubmodule X

      In a finite-dimensional distributive Hom category, every nonzero endomorphism radical has a single morphism whose principal two-sided span is the whole radical. This is the first operational part of the BGRS local parameter pi(X,X).
